newsitem.title: USA: High pressure lingers in Brazil coffee belt - WSC.
newsitem.headline: High pressure lingers in Brazil coffee belt - WSC.

text.p: The coming week should see continued warm, high pressure dominating Brazil's coffee belt, Weather Services Corp said in it's daily update for Wednesday.
Fair to partly cloudy skies were observed in the coffee belt this morning. Low temperatures have remained in the middle 50s to low 60s F (middle teens C).
Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected for the next seven days. Temperatures should stay near to above normal. Lows should range in the 50s to low 60s F (low to middle teens C).
The high pressure system should prevent any damaging cold weather from entering the region, according to WSC.
